newsitem.title: USA: VTEL, Compression Labs to merge.
newsitem.headline: VTEL, Compression Labs to merge.

text.p: VTEL Corp and Compression Labs Inc said on Tuesday that their boards have approved a definitive agreement to merge the two corporations in a transaction valued in excess of $80 million.
The agreement provides for a stock-for-stock exchange in which each share of Compression Labs common stock will be exchanged for 0.46 of a VTEL share.
VTEL said it expects to issue about 8.4 million new common shares. The new shares will represent about 38 percent of VTEL's ownership.

The companies said that one-time expenses related to the transaction will be incurred at closing and will have a dilutive effect on VTEL's earnings. The transaction is expected to close in VTEL's fourth fiscal quarter ending July 31, 1997.
Thereafter, the transaction is expected to be accretive to VTEL's earnings in fiscal year 1998.
The new entity will retain the VTEL name and will have annualized revenue of nearly $200 million.
